project.name: Denhead
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 5 of 13: every visitor category, strict boundary, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, construction dates, access, transport and dogs were rechecked before continuing. Craigtoun Country Park café, toilets, picnic tables and attractions are outside Denhead. St Andrews services are not transferred.

touristAppeal.label: Limited Visitor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Denhead is a rural hamlet crossed by the final Fife Pilgrim Way stage, but it has no independent visitor attraction, qualifying café or public facilities. The route is useful context without turning the hamlet into a 60+ destination.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: The official stage requires dogs on leads around farms and livestock; road sections without pavement also reduce comfort.
